name: OpenAI Compatible Provider
description: Provider for OpenAI compatible APIs (DeepSeek, etc.).
project_description: A flexible AI-module provider for any service that follows the OpenAI API specification — DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, Zhipu AI (BigModel), Alibaba Cloud (Tongyi Qianwen), 01.AI (Yi), Moonshot AI (Kimi) and similar. An administrator sets a base API endpoint URL plus an API key (stored through the Key module) and defines one or more models with their operation types, capabilities and per-model parameters via an admin form; the models can also be seeded from config. It ships with DeepSeek chat and reasoner models as defaults. Chat and any operation types the configured models declare are exposed to the AI module.
